sources.title: Agent of Empires README.md
sources.finding: AoE manages parallel persistent tmux sessions on Linux/macOS, with CLI/TUI/browser/API access, optional worktrees/containers, phone browser access and SSH reconnect. Windows is WSL2 only.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/cli/reference.md
sources.locator: aoe add; send; ps; agents; acp
sources.finding: CLI creates, lists, sends to, forks and removes sessions. Custom commands and ACP agent/model/effort selection are supported; named resume/fork examples include Claude, Codex, OpenCode and Pi.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/web-dashboard.md
sources.finding: The shipped dashboard drives sessions from a browser; tmux and persistent structured workers survive browser crashes. Remote access supports authenticated tunnel modes and read-only views.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/api.md
sources.finding: HTTP and typed MCP operations expose session management. Authentication and read-only restrictions vary by daemon launch mode.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/mcp-control.md
sources.finding: MCP control is opt-in, off by default; it exposes session operations under daemon credentials. It adds no per-tool permissions beyond the connected users access.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/mcp-servers.md
sources.finding: AoE forwards configured MCP server definitions to structured-view agents when a session starts; terminal sessions run the agent's own CLI, which loads MCP configuration itself. This is distinct from AoE's inbound control MCP server.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/sandbox.md
sources.finding: Optional Docker (default), Podman or Apple Container runs the agent in a private container with the project mounted at /workspace, configurable CPU and memory limits and per-session agent stores. Claude refresh credentials are shared across sandbox sessions, with documented refresh conflicts. The guide documents no network policy settings.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/worktrees.md
sources.finding: Git worktrees isolate session working copies/branches; they are separate from container security controls.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/session-resume.md
sources.finding: Resume/fork support depends on harness, store and OS. Codex with ChatGPT login is explicitly refused for managed resume/fork, and unsandboxed macOS Codex has additional limits.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/diff-view.md
sources.finding: Diff UI supports comparison bases and line comments sent as follow-up prompts. Comments are localStorage per session and move to a stale block when code changes.

sources.title: Agent of Empires docs/telemetry.md
sources.finding: Anonymous telemetry is opt-in, off by default. aoe telemetry disable and DO_NOT_TRACK suppress sending; settings expose consent and reset controls.

sources.title: Agent of Empires LICENSE
sources.finding: AoE is MIT licensed, with an Apache-2.0-derived file separately disclosed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.

sources.finding: The supported-agent list names Claude Code, OpenCode, Mistral Vibe, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI, Cursor CLI, Copilot CLI, Pi, Oh My Pi, Factory Droid, Hermes, Kiro CLI, Qwen Code, Kimi Code and Prime Agent, auto-detected when installed.

sources.title: Agent of Empires structured view, Supported agents table
sources.locator: docs/structured-view.md lines 18-36 (agent, adapter, install and auth table), release v1.22.3 commit 8d2921c
sources.finding: Each agent authenticates through its own CLI login or provider key: Claude via claude auth login or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, Codex via codex login or OPENAI_API_KEY, Gemini via API key, OAuth or Vertex. Gemini CLI is marked deprecated upstream for individual accounts; Cursor and others run in the terminal view.
